Please open Shizuku and check this app in the authorization list!\nIf you can\'t find this app in Shizuku\'s authorization list, please close Shizuku from recent tasks and reopen it.

Huawei (including Honor) devices may encounter compatibility issues (as it is said that they use the A protocol for touch control). \nThe project author (github.com/k3x1n) is unable to adapt due to the lack of Huawei devices.

To avoid screen freezing caused by compatibility issues, please click [Continue] within 5 seconds. Otherwise, Show Taps will automatically stop.\nIf you find that the screen is frozen and you cannot click the [Continue] button, try clicking the [Switch Mode] button, and then click [Start] again.
